content.study:
Section 57 — Conditions for enforcement of foreign awards

Section 57 sets out the statutory conditions for enforcement of Geneva Convention foreign awards, including validity, notice and opportunity, scope of submission, composition/procedure, binding status and the statutory public-policy and arbitrability limitations.

Apply the provision within Chapter II of Part II and identify the precise Convention framework, statutory condition and enforcement consequence. Do not treat enforcement as a merits appeal.
